§3§lOptional administration notes§r
This quest is for server administrators and is not a prerequisite for other quests. Gifts, trades, sign-in and lottery each have configuration files under config/gtit.

§3§lTrade editing and reload§r
Use /gtit nekovm edit on|off to switch trade editing mode and modify entries in the vending-machine GUI. After saving the configuration, use /gtit nekovm reload to reload it.

§3§lQuest gating and completion§r
Gate IDs accept high:low, UUID, standard Base64 and URL-safe Base64; padding is optional for the last form. §cGates allow access if BetterQuesting is absent or its query fails.§r Administrators should verify the configuration and dependencies. Read these notes, then tick the checkbox.
